The '''1939 National Division''' was the third edition of the [[Turkish National Division]]. [[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] won their first title.

==Participants==

*[[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] - [[1938–39 Istanbul Football League]], 1st
*[[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] - [[1938–39 Istanbul Football League]], 2nd
*[[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] - [[1938–39 Istanbul Football League]], 3rd
*[[Vefa S.K.|Vefa]] - [[1938–39 Istanbul Football League]], 4th
*[[Ankara Demirspor]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 1st
*[[MKE Ankaragücü|AS-FA Gücü]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 2nd
*Doğanspor - [[İzmir Football League]], 1st
*[[İzmirspor|Ateşspor]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 2nd
